originalTitle: SHERI MOON ZOMBIE - I Love My Robot (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
content: Cult icon SHERI MOON ZOMBIE unveils debut single and video "I Love My Robot." Limited edition picture disc vinyl featuring "I Love My Robot" on Side A and @RobZombie "Sir Lord Acid Wolfman" on Side B available for pre-order. Only 600 copies worldwide. Out October 30, 2026 via Nuclear Blast Records. 🛒 SHOP & LISTEN 🎧 https://smz.bfan.link/i-love-my-robot.yde Directed by ROB ZOMBIE VISIT SHERI MOON ZOMBIE https://www.instagram.com/sherimoonzombieofficial --- Cult icon, actress, designer, and longtime horror favorite SHERI MOON ZOMBIE expands her creative universe today with the release of her debut single and music video, "I Love My Robot." Helmed by acclaimed producer Zeuss and accompanied by a video directed by ROB ZOMBIE, the track blends retro sci-fi, playful camp, and infectious hooks into an irresistibly offbeat anthem that is unmistakably SHERI. Equal parts tongue-in-cheek and surprisingly timely, "I Love My Robot" offers a witty take on life in an increasingly algorithm-driven world. Beneath its infectious energy and B-movie charm, the song celebrates imagination, individuality, and the simple joy of thinking for yourself. It's a playful reminder that while technology may make life easier, nothing can replace genuine creativity or human connection. Coinciding with today's release, Nuclear Blast has launched pre-orders for an exclusive 12-inch picture disc featuring "I Love My Robot" on Side A and Rob Zombie's "Sir Lord Acid Wolfman" on Side B. Limited to just 600 copies worldwide (500 US / 100 EU), the one-time pressing is scheduled for release on October 30, making it an essential collector's item for fans of the Zombie universe. --- "I LOVE MY ROBOT" LYRICS AI AI I don’t need your AI AI AI You’re a vampire suckin me dry uh Give me a book to read You can’t have my brain to feed uh What’s my color I need to know I gotta pick a shirt for the show But But But But I love my robot I love my roomba It cleans my floor And it it goes a zoom a X2 AI AI I don’t need your AI AI AI Your a vampire suckin me dry uh I’ll scribe my own song this very night Don’t type words out for me it just ain’t right uh I don’t like the shows you suggest I pick my programs cos I know me best But But But But I love my robot I love my roomba It cleans my floor And it it goes a zoom a X2 Words per minute are 60 plus but I can voice it now without a fuss uh Newsie reporters would give us the scoop Now only cogs are singing the blues BUT BUT BUT BUT CHORUS X2 --- #SheriMoonZombie #RockMusic #Rock #NuclearBlast #NuclearBlastRecords

chineseContent: 邪教偶像 SHERI MOON ZOMBIE 推出首张单曲和视频“I Love My Robot”。限量版乙烯基图片光盘，A 面印有“I Love My Robot”，B 面印有 @RobZombie“Sir Lord Acid Wolfman”，可供预订。全球仅有 600 份。通过 Nuclear Blast Records 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日发布。 🛒 购物和聆听 🎧 https://smz.bfan.link/i-love-my-robot.yde 由 ROB ZOMBIE 执导 访问 SHERI MOON ZOMBIE https://www.instagram.com/sherimoonzombieofficial --- 邪教偶像、女演员、设计师和长期以来的恐怖最爱 SHERI MOON ZOMBIE 今天发布了她的首张单曲和音乐，扩展了她的创意宇宙视频“我爱我的机器人”。这首歌曲由广受好评的制作人 Zeuss 执导，并配有 ROB ZOMBIE 执导的视频，将复古科幻、俏皮的营地和富有感染力的旋律融合在一起，形成一首令人难以抗拒的另类赞歌，毫无疑问是 SHERI。 《我爱我的机器人》既半开玩笑又出人意料地及时，以诙谐的方式讲述了日益由算法驱动的世界中的生活。在其富有感染力的能量和 B 级电影的魅力之下，这首歌颂扬了想象力、个性和独立思考的简单快乐。这是一个有趣的提醒，虽然技术可以让生活变得更轻松，但没有什么可以取代真正的创造力或人与人之间的联系。在今天发布的同时，Nuclear Blast 还推出了一张独家 12 英寸图片光盘的预订，其中 A 面为“I Love My Robot”，B 面为 Rob Zombie 的“Sir Lord Acid Wolfman”。全球限量 600 份（美国 500 张/欧盟 100 张），一次性印刷计划于 10 月 30 日发行，使其成为僵尸宇宙粉丝的必备收藏品。 --- “我爱我的机器人”歌词 AI AI 我不需要你 AI AI AI 你是一个吸血鬼，把我吸干了 呃 给我一本书读 你不能拥有
